newsitem.title: FRANCE: Germond named head of SFR telcoms group.
newsitem.headline: Germond named head of SFR telcoms group.

text.p: Generale des Eaux said it had named Philippe Germond as chairman of mobile telecoms group SFR and head of CEGETEL, the telecoms venture which aims to compete with France Telecom.
Germond replaces Philippe Glotin at SFR and CEGETEL, who died suddenly this Christmas.
Generale des Eaux named Henri Proglio as joint managing director. Antoine Zacharias and Jean-Dominique Deschamps were already managing directors reporting to executive chairman Jean-Marie Messier.
The company said it had made Armand Buffin, Daniel Caille, Guillaume Hannezo and Eric Licoys directors of the company. Hannezo is the finance director.
Pierre Schulhof, Jean-Pierre Tardieu and Michel Villaneau were already directors of the company.
